messages.subject: Unaligned Tile Circular Tree.
parts:
Hello everyone, 

I have been using geom_fruit / geom_tile to create the tree below but the tiles are all unaligned. From the examples I have seen so far, they should be automatically aligned, so I am not quite sure it is going on. Any help will be appreciated.

# Creates base phylogeny ~
basePhylo2 <-
  ggtree(Data2, layout = "fan", aes(colour = group), size = .125) +
  scale_colour_manual(labels = c("Columba livia", "Columba rupestris"), values = c("#000000", "#fb8072"))

# Merges annotation to base phylogeny ~
basePhylo2_annot <- basePhylo2 %<+% Data2_annot

# Creates final phylo ~
basePhylo2_annot + 
  geom_fruit(
    geom = geom_tile,
    mapping = aes(y = label, x = BioStatus, fill = BioStatus),
    offset = .08,
    pwidth = .25)



Thanks in advance, George.
